title: Minding the Bread Stall

readiness.math: counting on from a price to give change; checking what was paid
readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: I have to take a batch out of the oven. Would you mind my stall for a little while? I trust you.

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: Count the change from the price, just like you did with Mrs. Ruth. And always check what the customer gives you.

steps.speaker: tobias
steps.prompt: The {item} costs {price}. The customer gave you {paid}. Count the change onto the counter, then press Give change.

feedback.honest: Oh! I gave you one coin too many. Thank you for telling me. Mr. Tobias has a very honest helper!
feedback.all_good: The stall is minded, and every coin is right.

outro.speaker: tobias
outro.text: You told the customer about the extra coin? That's what being trustworthy means. I'm proud of you.

journal_line: I minded Mr. Tobias's bread stall, counted the change, and was honest about an extra coin.
unavailable_text: The stall is minded for today.
